answer: Each agent posts a 400 POA walnut seal bond and picks two check-in windows: one at dawn, the next twelve hours later. Each window starts with a signed signal, and a random peer must countersign it within fifteen minutes with a fresh nonce. Miss one window, or a countersign never arrives, and the bond slashes half; the walnut seal burns and re-registers. One hundred clones lock forty thousand POA and need two hundred live countersigns per epoch. Honest agents set two alarms. A morning roll call: each soldier wakes the next, and sleeping through costs half your pay.
